sections.skill: Write and judge a clear offer

questions.prompt: Which offer is the clearest?

choices.text: Our company has many years of fitness experience in sports.
We offer the very best fitness services and the highest quality for all of you.
Fitness for everyone, everywhere, always, at great prices.
For new runners, we create 8-week plans to help you finish your first 5K.

questions.correct_answer: For new runners, we create 8-week plans to help you finish your first 5K.
questions.intro: An offer (also called a value proposition) says, in plain words, who it is for, what problem it solves, and what result the customer gets. A simple pattern: "For [customer] who [problem], we [what you do] so you can [result]." For example: "For busy pet owners who work late, we walk your dog at lunch so it gets exercise and you do not rush home." A clear offer is specific, honest and easy to repeat. It avoids vague phrases like "best quality" that do not say what the customer gets.
questions.feedback: It names the customer, the help and the result.

questions.prompt: What three parts should a clear offer include?

choices.text: A slogan, a logo, and a list of the owner's hobbies

A discount, a deadline, and a free gift for every buyer
The founding date, the address, and the office hours

questions.correct_answer: The customer, the problem, and the result they get

questions.prompt: In "Busy commuters: car washed in 10 minutes," who is the customer?

choices.text: The coffee shop
The car wash owner
Busy commuters
The cars

questions.correct_answer: Busy commuters
questions.intro: An offer answers three questions a customer silently asks: "Is this for me?", "Does it fix my problem?", and "What will I get?" Think of a sign at a car wash: "Busy commuters: get your car washed in 10 minutes while you wait for coffee." It tells who (busy commuters), the problem (no time) and the result (a clean car in 10 minutes). If a sign only says "Quality car care," the customer cannot answer any of the three questions.
questions.feedback: Busy commuters are named as the customer.
